cards.headline: The tape: a mixed, rotational tape, 46% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.36% · WTI +0.15% · Brent -0.38% · NatGas +1.65%. 46% of 67 energy names are green — a mixed, rotational tape. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +6.40%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +6.40%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -1.95%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ARRY is the standout at +22.63%
cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +22.63%, BE +9.12%, SEDG +8.96%, ENPH +8.92%, EOSE +7.67%. Laggards: FANG -3.70%, MPLX -2.48%, PEG -2.25%, APA -2.23%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ARRY moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ARRY is +22.11% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
